" alt="Off-grid lithium battery and inverter electrical bay" class="w-full h-full object-cover" loading="lazy" />

        <form id="enquiry-form" name="production-brief" method="POST" data-netlify="true" netlify-honeypot="bot-field" novalidate class="mt-12 bg-ivory hairline-all p-6 sm:p-10 space-y-6">
          <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="production-brief" />

          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">

            </div>
            <div>

              <input id="f-name" name="name" type="text" required placeholder="Full name" class="w-full bg-alabaster border border-sand px-4 py-3 text-sm text-espresso placeholder:text-umber/50 focus:border-bronze focus:outline-none" />

            <div>

            </div>
            <div>
              <label for="f-location" class="block font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-umber mb-2">Location / Suburb *</label>
              <input id="f-location" name="location" type="text" required placeholder="e.g. Campbellfield, VIC" class="w-full bg-alabaster border border-sand px-4 py-3 text-sm text-espresso placeholder:text-umber/50 focus:border-bronze focus:outline-none" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label for="f-shoot-type" class="block font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-umber mb-2">Production Package *</label>
              <select id="f-shoot-type" name="shootType" required class="w-full bg-alabaster border border-sand px-4 py-3 text-sm text-espresso focus:border-bronze focus:outline-none">
                <option value="">Select production package</option>
                <option value="Flagship Model Launch (Stills + Film)">Flagship Model Launch (Stills + Film)</option>
                <option value="Dealer Yard Content Day">Dealer Yard Content Day</option>
                <option value="Full Range & Expo Campaign">Full Range &amp; Expo Campaign</option>
                <option value="Custom Commercial Production">Custom Commercial Production</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label for="f-models" class="block font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-umber mb-2">Models *</label>
                <input id="f-models" name="models" type="number" min="1" max="50" value="1" required class="w-full bg-alabaster border border-sand px-4 py-3 text-sm text-espresso focus:border-bronze focus:outline-none" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label for="f-timeframe" class="block font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-umber mb-2">Timeframe *</label>
                <select id="f-timeframe" name="timeframe" required class="w-full bg-alabaster border border-sand px-4 py-3 text-sm text-espresso focus:border-bronze focus:outline-none">
                  <option value="Within 2–4 weeks">Within 2–4 weeks</option>
                  <option value="Next 1–2 months">Next 1–2 months</option>
                  <option value="Ahead of Caravan Show">Ahead of Caravan Show</option>
                  <option value="Planning / Exploratory">Planning / Exploratory</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label for="f-notes" class="block font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-umber mb-2">Project Scope, Add-Ons &amp; Channels *</label>
            <textarea id="f-notes" name="notes" rows="4" required placeholder="Share model specs, factory vs. location preference, key features to highlight, and where assets will be used..." class="w-full bg-alabaster border border-sand px-4 py-3 text-sm text-espresso placeholder:text-umber/50 focus:border-bronze focus:outline-none"></textarea>
          </div>

          <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
            <input id="f-consent" name="consent" value="yes" type="checkbox" required class="mt-1 accent-[#9A6B38]" />
            <label for="f-consent" class="text-xs text-umber leading-relaxed">

            </label>
          </div>

          <div id="form-error" class="hidden p-4 border border-red-400 bg-red-50 text-xs text-red-800 font-mono"></div>

          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 pt-2">
            <p class="text-xs text-umber">On a *.netlify.app deployment, submission is attempted via Netlify Forms. In local or embedded previews it only prepares a copyable brief; no enquiry is sent.</p>
            <button type="submit" class="px-7 py-3.5 bg-espresso text-ivory text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] hover:bg-bronze transition-colors">

            </button>
          </div>

          <div id="brief-ready-panel" class="hidden mt-6 p-6 bg-alabaster border border-bronze/50 space-y-4">

            <pre id="brief-output-text" class="text-xs font-mono text-espresso bg-ivory p-4 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap hairline-all"></pre>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <a id="brief-mailto-link" href="#" class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-espresso text-ivory text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-bronze">Open in Email Client</a>
              <button id="copy-brief-btn" type="button" class="px-5 py-2.5 border border-espresso/25 bg-ivory text-espresso text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider hover:border-bronze hover:text-bronze">Copy Brief</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </section>
